selection: Every recorded current-agent decision at an idle simultaneous move request, with more than one legal own action, exactly one living party member on one side and two or three on the other. No selection by result, chosen action, value or opponent hidden information.
scope: Exploratory extension of the frozen native deployed comparison. These are not fresh independent games. True hidden state is fixed; the analysis bounds full-information optimal continuation with a specified pure first action. It does not certify the blind information-set policy or human-relative strength. Normal bot unchanged.
bounds: For each joint action, L=P(own win)+0.5*P(tie), U=L+P(nonterminal)+P(unexpanded). Subtract/add 1e-9 outward padding and clip to [0,1]. Alternative security lower=min_reply L; selected security upper=min_reply U. max_alternative_lower minus selected_security_upper > 1e-8 certifies conditional pure-action security loss. Unresolved mass is never treated as a loss.
budget: One 256-run partial enumeration per legal joint action; no adaptive budget extension in this study. Repeat the complete extraction and scan and require identical non-timing results.
controls: one reply suffices to bound selected security above
all replies required for alternative security below
prior_failure: Generic endgame search integration and deeper bound scheduling already failed performance or strength gates. This study only checks the previously excluded asymmetric native roots for one-step outcome certificates.
